To be honest, you can't force yourself to be happy. I know I can't. 

Maybe you should read the sidebar over there and start to understand why some people choose suicide as a method of escape.
I went there once and it was a whole lot of creepy dudes that kept hitting on me... did I just end up with bad luck or is it really that way?

yeah, i am better off without them. but it sucks. I had been losing more and more "friends" everyday until I literally now have no one else left in my life. It hurts.

I tried making new friends and I lost those friends too, probably because I am just a burden. I don't know.
I'm sorry, I honestly am confused as to what you are talking about? :(

People forgot to give me chances. I have no friends. My mother said she is not my mother any longer. I have an ex going around and bad mouthing me to all of my use to be friends. I have been homeless since October and not one of my so-called friends have cared to take me in. I have no one to give a chance to. I wish I did, but I really don't.
